tool-permissions.original_pending: The original decision result is unconfirmed. Check the same operation without selecting another option again.
tool-permissions.intent_unavailable: The original submission cannot be verified. Actions are paused; keep the record and retry reading.
tool-permissions.access_denied: You can no longer view or decide these requests. Check your current project access.
tool-permissions.background_paused: Automatic reads are paused. Refresh manually to check the latest requests.
tool-permissions.permission_scope: Each decision applies only to this request in the node's current attempt. The process remains active and retains its execution slot while waiting.
tool-permissions.no_permissions: No permission requests have been saved for this node yet.
tool-permissions.incomplete_details: The request details are incomplete. Approval is unavailable; you can still reject this request.
tool-permissions.decision_boundary: Saving a decision does not establish that the runner has read it or the provider has applied it. It grants no lasting permission.
tool-permissions.invalid_read: Permission data does not match the current execution source. Check it again.
tool-permissions.refresh_failed: Current permission requests could not be read. The original decision and conflict are retained.
tool-permissions.unsupported_scope: This request exceeds the scope that can be approved. You can still decline or cancel it.
tool-permissions.observation_unknown: The original response outcome is unconfirmed. Do not approve it again.
tool-permissions.observation_boundary: Writing a response or resolving a request does not establish operation success. A cancel decision does not prove the remote process stopped.
tool-permissions.historical_readonly: This request belongs to a historical attempt and is read-only. An unconfirmed original operation can still be reconciled.
tool-permissions.claude_parameter_bounda: Review the complete original parameters below. This decision applies only to this SDK callback; it changes neither the input nor lasting permissions. Reject if you cannot verify it.
tool-permissions.claude_reply_written: Fully written to the local SDK host
tool-permissions.claude_observation_boun: Writing to the local SDK host does not establish provider acceptance, successful tool execution or lasting permission. Execution closure and actual process stop remain separate facts.
tool-permissions.claude_reason: Reason for this decision (optional; do not enter credentials)
tool-permissions.claude_reason_invalid: This reason cannot be adopted. Shorten it and remove unsupported characters. The original text is preserved.
